technical_data.sample_sensitive_file_content:
%PDF-1.4
% Marketing strategy Q2 2024
Confidential and proprietary information.

indicators: Google Cloud Storage IAM policy binding includes 'allUsers' with 'roles/storage.objectViewer'
Anonymous GET requests recorded in audit logs retrieving sensitive PDF files
HTTP 200 OK responses from GCS bucket for sensitive documents without authentication
Uniform bucket-level access disabled allowing legacy ACLs to grant public access
gsutil commands executed without authentication or with anonymous user context
samples.detection_method: GCP Security Command Center alerts on public bucket permissions; audit log analysis detecting anonymous object read operations; automated scanning tools for bucket ACLs and IAM policies; periodic manual reviews of bucket uniform access settings; alerting on 'allUsers' or 'allAuthenticatedUsers' bindings for sensitive buckets.
relevant_mitre_techniques: T1530 - Data from Cloud Storage Object
T1537 - Transfer Data to Cloud Account

samples.scenario: Azure Blob Storage container configured with public access level set to 'Container', allowing anonymous users to list and read blobs, resulting in exposure of internal project documentation.

technical_data.sample_sensitive_file_content:
Project Alpha Specifications

Confidential - Internal Use Only

Requirements, design, and implementation details...
awscli_command_sequence: az storage container show-permission --account-name corpprojectdocs --name internal-docs
az storage blob download --account-name corpprojectdocs --container-name internal-docs --name project_alpha_specifications.docx --file ./project_alpha_specifications.docx

indicators: Azure Blob Storage container public access set to 'Container' allowing anonymous list and read
Anonymous GET blob requests recorded from external IPs in Azure Storage logs
HTTP 200 OK responses for downloading internal project documentation files without auth
Azure CLI commands run or simulated without authentication context
Presence of sensitive internal documents accessible via public blob storage URLs
samples.detection_method: Azure Security Center detecting public access on sensitive storage containers; storage analytics logs monitoring anonymous read or list operations; automated periodic scans for public container access levels; alerts on anonymous HTTP GET requests to blob storage endpoints; manual policy reviews for container access configurations.
relevant_mitre_techniques: T1530 - Data from Cloud Storage Object
T1537 - Transfer Data to Cloud Account

samples.scenario: Google Cloud Storage bucket configured with uniform bucket-level access disabled and an IAM policy granting allUsers the 'roles/storage.objectViewer' role, resulting in public read access to sensitive project files.
indicators: GCS bucket IAM policy binds allUsers to roles/storage.objectViewer
Audit logs show anonymous user fetching storage.objects.get on sensitive JSON config file
HTTP 200 OK response serving database credential file without authentication
Use of gsutil and gcloud commands to retrieve bucket policy and copy files publicly
Anonymous access IP 203.0.113.45 seen in audit logs accessing bucket resources
samples.detection_method: GCP Security Command Center detecting overly permissive IAM policies; audit log analysis for unauthenticated storage.objects.get events; network IDS monitoring client IPs and user-agent strings indicating anonymous access; scheduled bucket permission audits with alerts on allUsers bindings; alerting on public downloads of sensitive files.
relevant_mitre_techniques: T1530 - Data from Cloud Storage Object
T1537 - Transfer Data to Cloud Account
